move: lines rotate up tilted on left baseline, overshoot flat, elastic snap
how: A red stage with four corner labels and three 170px uppercase lines (the middle one white) in overflow-hidden rows, each with transform-origin at its left baseline. Corners fade in. Each line comes from yPercent 120 rotation 12 to 0/0 (expo.out, 0.55s) starting 0.14s apart from 2.5%, then overshoots to rotation -2.5 (power2.out, 0.12s) and settles to 0 with elastic.out(1,0.4). At 72% the lines tilt to rotation -10 and fly up yPercent -120 (power3.in) 0.08s apart and the corners fade.
adapt: Change the three lines and corner labels, the colours and which line is highlighted; keep the 12deg tilt, 0.55s expo.out entry and the -2.5 overshoot with elastic settle.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the rows and corners; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with line i at (0.025 + i*0.07)D and exit at 0.725D. Scope selectors to el; direct port.
